posts.title: Moved to Miami
posts.description: Ryan emailed 3,000 CEOs from his bedroom in London. Hey [CEO name]. I just moved to [your city]. Got some growth hack ideas for your company. Can I walk you through them over a coffee? All of a sudden, Ryan had leads. Most of the replies came from Miami.

posts.title: You can see everything
posts.description: I spent 3 hours watching this documentary and another 3 days thinking about it. Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes (Liz) invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. The crew is led by comedian Nathan Fielder (Nat)
